literal_semantic_review.literal_label: Espace ouvert d’usage collectif / principe de coordination des aménagements entre parcelles et prédominance végétale
literal_semantic_review.meaning: A1 policy for generous, attractive private open spaces of collective use, coordinated across parcels, with vegetation dominant; improve shared resident use, planting and trees, limit surface parking, and involve residents when existing spaces are redesigned.
literal_semantic_review.implementation: A1.1 sectoral plans d’affectation; associated built-heritage and major-tree/garden objectives remain. A2 programming and A3 equipment opportunity studies are separate categories and not inferred from this support.

native_pattern_mapping.difference: Pattern phase translation only; preserve each original matrix.

limits: The original filled source contour is a thematic support, not a legal parcel/project perimeter.
Collective use does not establish public ownership, unrestricted public access, a registered easement, or current condition.
No building right, available capacity, building prohibition, binding parking count, or site-specific preservation designation inferred.
Whole raw hull and Vevey gates apply before source visibility; do not crop to manufacture eligibility.
Private contextual positive-area parcel overlaps only; no qualification or completeness promotion.
Neighbouring municipal indications remain strictly indicative and require intercommunal coordination.

signed_approval.scope: Signed whole municipal PDCom. Territorial project objectives, principles and measures guide municipal implementation; not every historical diagnosis or population/capacity estimate is a current binding private right.
signed_approval.version_note: Signature sheet footer differs from main version; this distinction is preserved. Exact officially published signed PDF hash is verified; no rewritten or substituted source.

approval_review.diagnostic_vintage_limit: PDF11 explains capacity evaluation made2020/2021 from draft zoning revisions and existing built surfaces; horizon2040 projections and diagnostic data must retain their source dates, not treated as current parcel rights or remaining unbuilt capacity.
limits: Approved municipal main source distinct from regional Rivelac plans or former1997 PDCom.
Original signature PDF149 is image-only for native-text extraction; visual approval evidence is separate, not an OCR transcript.
Cover22Aug2024 and approval-sheet footer2Apr2024 remain distinguishable; approval date2Oct2024 is visually stamped and independently corroborated.
Source project objectives/principles/measures PDF43 do not turn diagnostic estimates, proposed zoning or development horizons into current construction rights.
No geometry qualification, parcel intersections, full-text completeness or commune completion is asserted; all empty/native-text gaps remain auditable.

currentness_evidence.finding: Municipal synthesis confirms council1February2024/canton2October2024 and entry into force.
